description:
SGP is seeking organized, detail-oriented Capture Coordinators to support a dedicated engagement with an established federal contractor holding multiple certifications. You will support an established capture organization by managing data entry, pipeline tracking, documentation, and administrative activities that allow capture managers to focus on strategy and customer engagement. The client's portfolio spans IT and cybersecurity, telecommunications, physical security, audiovisual systems, and federal construction supporting defense and civilian agencies.

You'll bring strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a willingness to learn while managing recurring responsibilities with accuracy and consistency. You'll collaborate with capture managers, proposal managers, proposal coordinators, writers, and pricing professionals to maintain organized capture activities and support an effective transition to proposal development. Prior 1099 consulting experience is a plus.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $100–$115 per hour.

Security Clearance: Active security clearance or ability to obtain one.

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you’ll retain the independence of contract work while accessing a collaborative network of resources to support successful engagements.

  • Select consultant network: Join a network of experienced capture and proposal professionals who have diverse expertise and collaborate to support client needs across a variety of engagements.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting while working within the agreed-upon requirements and expectations of the client engagement.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • A path to grow: Collaborate with experienced capture managers and gain exposure to capture research, planning, and analysis activities that support federal business development efforts.

Responsibilities

  • Enter, update, and maintain opportunity records in GovSignal, including stages, due dates, contacts, documents, and notes, to ensure pipeline data remains accurate and current

  • Run saved searches in GovSignal and SAM.gov for new sources sought notices, RFIs, draft RFPs, and task orders; log opportunities and route them to the assigned capture manager

  • Deduplicate, tag, and audit pipeline data on a recurring schedule; flag stale or incomplete records for follow-up

  • Track amendments, question-and-answer (Q&A) releases, and due date changes; summarize key updates for the capture team

  • Produce recurring pipeline reports and dashboards using GovSignal and Excel to support capture and leadership reviews

  • Conduct preliminary eligibility checks based on NAICS codes, size standards, set-aside classifications, and contract vehicle requirements for capture manager review

  • Gather customer, incumbent, and competitor research to support profiles, call plans, and capture plans

  • Assist in assembling bid/no-bid packages and gate review materials using input from capture managers

  • Track teaming partner outreach, nondisclosure agreements (NDAs), teaming agreements, and partner data calls

  • Prepare RFI and sources sought response shells, capability statements, and compliance checklists for capture manager review

  • Maintain the capture library, including past performance summaries, capability narratives, and qualification data

  • Schedule capture meetings, document meeting minutes, and track action items and decisions through completion

  • Organize capture materials in SharePoint to support an efficient handoff to the proposal team

Required Qualifications

  • 1 to 3 years of experience supporting federal capture, business development, proposals, or contracts; candidates with strong administrative or data management experience in another field will also be considered

  • Basic familiarity with SAM.gov and the federal acquisition process, or a strong interest in learning about federal contracting

  • Experience performing high-volume data entry and maintaining records in a CRM, database, or tracking tool.

  • Strong research, organizational, and written communication skills, with exceptional attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage a high volume of recurring tasks and deadlines, follow direction, and adapt to evolving processes.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel (including sorting, filtering, pivot tables, and lookup functions), PowerPoint, Teams, and SharePoint.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with GovSignal.

  • Exposure to federal pursuits involving IT and cybersecurity, telecommunications, physical security, audiovisual systems, or federal construction.

  • Familiarity with Department of Defense (DoD) and civilian agency customers, including the Army, Navy, Air Force, NAVFAC, USACE, DHS, Department of State, GSA, NIH, and Department of the Interior.

  • Exposure to task order processes under GSA MAS, OASIS+, IDIQ contracts, or blanket purchase agreements (BPAs).

  • Experience supporting 8(a), HUBZone, or other small-business set-aside pursuits.

  • Experience with GovWin, HigherGov, GovTribe, Salesforce, or similar opportunity intelligence and CRM platforms.

  • Active security clearance or ability to obtain one.
